subject: french
title: Stamp 2: Assembly, Senate, and Europe
welcome_lead: Stamp the legislative chambers and France's role in Europe.
meta_desc: A-Level French adventure on the National Assembly, Senate, and France in the EU.

concepts.def: Lower house of parliament with 577 deputies elected by direct universal suffrage.
Upper house with 348 senators elected indirectly by local officials.
Constitutional Council ensuring laws conform to the constitution.
EU; France was a founding member of the EEC in 1957 (Treaty of Rome).
Common currency adopted by France in 1999 (notes and coins from 2002).
1985 agreement (effective 1995) abolishing border controls between member states.

walkthroughs.body_html: A bill (un projet de loi) is debated in the Assemblee nationale and the Senat. If they disagree, a joint committee meets. Ultimately the Assemblee has the final word.
France co-founded the EEC in 1957, helped create the Maastricht Treaty (1992) establishing the EU, and adopted the euro in 1999. The country remains a driving force in European integration.
Un depute = MP. Un senateur = senator. Le suffrage universel = universal suffrage. La cohabitation = when president and PM are from different parties.
